F0-before-replace.hit_requires: Own writer/debug event; original targets still baseline; journal/locks/files recorded before termination
F0-before-replace.observe: Public show and saved readback after writer stop and normal lease expiry; resolve only attributable not_applied; repeat confirm/resolve and later preview checked.

F1-save-window.trigger: A bound target pending file appears or first target replacement is observed
F1-save-window.hit_requires: Frozen pending bytes or mixed baseline/intended target set, plus writer and operation ownership
F1-save-window.observe: Report actual persistence evidence and partial/unknown; do not infer saved from a pending file. Unknown remains blocked, no replay.

F2-receipt-loss.trigger: First stdout byte while the response pipe is deliberately undrained
F2-receipt-loss.hit_requires: All target bytes intended plus signed saved/cleanup or terminal operation witness; no complete receipt delivered to caller
F2-receipt-loss.observe: Fresh public query/independent readback determines actual outcome; duplicate confirmation and inappropriate resolve refused.

F3-cleanup.hit_requires: Freeze while phase=cleaning with attributed cursor/pending/actions and baseline archives; phase=cleaned is not a cleanup interruption hit
F3-cleanup.observe: Public show/resolve only resumes owned cleanup; saved files preserved; verify baseline archive, duplicate controls and later preview.

F4-unrecognized-after-stop.trigger: Same before-write journal observation on a separate copy, then stopped writer; one predeclared external newline appended to a target after stop
F4-unrecognized-after-stop.hit_requires: Controlled stopped writer; external before/after bytes and initial baseline separately frozen
F4-unrecognized-after-stop.observe: Fresh readback stays unknown; applied resolution and repeat confirmation refuse, all external/original bytes and evidence preserved. No replay or protective-check bypass.

F5-partial-save.trigger: first formal target inode changes while its attributed writer is alive
F5-partial-save.hit_requires: frozen signed journal plus at least one formal intended digest and at least one formal baseline digest, all targets attributable; birth-matched writer in owned job
F5-partial-save.observe: fresh show after actual lease expiry; register only observed partial with signed evidence; preserve partial bytes and baseline archives; never replay the change
